name: The Palazzo at the Venetian
insider_take: This all-suite luxury tower brings Italian Renaissance grandeur to the Strip with the largest standard accommodations in Vegas.
whats_special: The Palazzo boasts the largest standard suites on the Strip at 720 square feet, each featuring sunken living areas and Italian marble bathrooms. Connected to the Venetian, guests enjoy access to over 160 shops at the Grand Canal Shoppes, complete with authentic gondola rides through indoor canals with singing gondoliers.
pro_tip: Book a suite on floors 35+ for stunning views of the Bellagio fountains and use the exclusive Prestige Lounge for expedited check-in and concierge services.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool deck offers cabanas with Strip views, while Michelin-starred dining includes CUT by Wolfgang Puck. The Canyon Ranch SpaClub spans 134,000 square feet across two floors, making it one of the largest spa facilities in North America.
pros: All-suite accommodations with spacious layouts and separate living areas
Premium location on Las Vegas Strip with direct access to luxury shopping
World-class dining options and celebrity chef restaurants
Elegant Italian-inspired architecture and sophisticated ambiance
cons: Busy Strip location with high tourist traffic
